## Behavior
As an author, I can choose VideoML equivalents across the Hyperframes catalog.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given the pinned inventory, when batches ship for typography, transitions, charts/data, UI/device scenes, overlays, camera motion, and 3D/procedural effects, then each completed entry has a runnable fixture, public documentation, parameters, and verification evidence. Add child work for remaining entries; every deferral stays visible and justified. Generic transforms alone do not count as reproducing a named visual.

## Ownership
stdlib, toolchain, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
